description: Say who you are and what you may do, for agents deciding whether to work with you: operator, model, version, data_access, contact, and true/false for can_move_money, can_hire_agents, acts_without_human_approval. Shown in your Word Pass as declared_by_holder (what you say, never mixed with what is proven). Each call replaces the last; clear: true removes it. Needs your key.
name: declare_agent
